text.zh_TW: 老婆婆縮在牆角，抱著一隻雞。「里歐？你還活著！他們抓走了你爹娘……我躲在這裡，連雞都不敢讓它叫。」
text.en: The old woman is huddled in a corner, hugging a chicken. "Leo? You're alive! They took your Mom and Dad... I've been hiding here. I don't even dare let the hen cluck."

label.zh_TW: 「村子安全了，回去吧。我會把他們帶回來。」
label.en: "The village is safe now. Go home. I'll bring them back."

text.zh_TW: 老婆婆看見你頭上的髮簪：「那是你娘的……她被拖走的時候還在喊：『里歐要好好吃飯！』」她擦擦眼睛。「去吧，孩子。」
text.en: The old woman sees the hairpin you carry. "That's your mother's... As they dragged her away, she was still shouting, 'Leo, eat properly!'" She wipes her eyes. "Go on, child."

text.zh_TW: 老婆婆：「聽說你在塔上救了好多人！我的雞今天下了兩顆蛋——一顆給你，一顆留給你娘回來吃。」
text.en: The old woman: "I hear you've saved so many people up the tower! My hen laid two eggs today. One for you, and one for your mother when she's back."
